list: Official 55-trophy list as served by PlayStation Network and the Xbox catalog on launch day, 19 November 2026

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Gone Fishing and it unlocks as the mission wraps up. Nothing in the official list marks it missable and no source reports a point of no return for it, so an ordinary story playthrough earns it. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Reach the mission Gone Fishing in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: Story-gated; no work beyond the campaign

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story and the trophy unlocks at the chapter break. It is the first checkpoint of the campaign and cannot be skipped. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Play through the opening of the story
Complete Chapter 1
The trophy unlocks at the chapter break
trophies.effort: Story-gated; the opening chapter only

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The name is censored on the platform itself - PlayStation and Xbox both serve it with the asterisks - so it appears that way here too. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 of the story
Complete the chapter
The trophy unlocks at the chapter break
trophies.effort: Story-gated; no work beyond the campaign

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story and the trophy unlocks at the chapter break. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Play through Chapter 3 of the story
Complete the chapter
The trophy unlocks at the chapter break
trophies.effort: Story-gated; no work beyond the campaign

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. The platform casing capitalises Of and The, and this guide keeps it exactly as served. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 of the story
Complete the chapter
The trophy unlocks at the chapter break

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story's gold: finish the final mission and the trophy unlocks as the campaign closes. Everything else in the game stays available around it, so treat this as the last page of the story rather than a point of no return for the rest of the list. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Play the story through to the final mission
Complete the final mission
The trophy unlocks as the campaign ends

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks on completion. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: Story-gated; no work beyond the campaign

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big score, and the trophy unlocks on completion. However you choose to run the heist itself, the unlock is tied to finishing the mission. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story
Complete the heist mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.requirements: Story progression to The Cartel Heist

steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion

Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion

trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks on completion. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.

Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The completion gold: bring the game's completion counter to 100%. Almost everything else on this list feeds it - story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration - so work the roadmap in order and use this tracker to see what is left. Push Square's launch coverage singles this trophy out by name, and the official description is the whole requirement: 100% completion, nothing vaguer. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start; Push Square.
steps: Work the roadmap steps in order - nearly every trophy feeds the counter
Use the in-game completion percentage to find what remains
Reach 100% completion and the trophy unlocks
trophies.effort: The long haul; most of the rest of this list combined

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts - the jumps and stunt spots scattered across Leonida. The official description sets the target at 250, so treat it as a background grind: clear stunts as you cross the map for other trophies instead of saving them all for the end. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Attempt stunt jumps and stunt spots as you travel
Keep a running count - the target is 250 completions
The trophy unlocks at the 250th completed stunt
trophies.effort: A long background grind across the whole playthrough

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once - one attempt each is enough, winning is not required. Work down the activity list in the tracker: ranges, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest, sampling each as it opens up. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Open each type of activity as it becomes available
Make at least one attempt at every type
The trophy unlocks once every type has been tried
trophies.requirements: One attempt at every activity type
trophies.effort: Short; an hour of sampling across the map

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. The official description is exact about the bar - gold in all of them, not a clear - so learn each challenge's scoring, replay the ones that fall short, and save this for when your aim and loadout are dialled in. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range challenges
Earn gold medals challenge by challenge, replaying any that fall short
The trophy unlocks when every challenge holds a gold
trophies.requirements: Gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges
trophies.effort: Moderate; skill-based replays at the range

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one - a win at each site, not just an entry. Clear them location by location as you explore, and replay a course until the win lands before moving on. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location
Win the race at that location
The trophy unlocks when every location has a win
trophies.requirements: A drone race win at every Top Fun location
trophies.effort: Moderate; one winning run per location

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races - the official wording says different, so repeats of a favourite course do not advance the count. Spread your entries across the race calendar and bank one win in each new event. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Enter races across the state, favouring ones you have not won
Bank a win in 20 different races
The trophy unlocks at the 20th distinct win
trophies.effort: Moderate; steady racing across the playthrough

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the named rival in the official description, so this is a head-to-head: take his challenge when fishing opens up and out-fish him. If the first attempt falls short, the challenge can be retried - nothing marks it missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal's challenge
Enter the fishing challenge against Cal
Out-fish him and the trophy unlocks
trophies.requirements: Win the fishing challenge against Cal
trophies.effort: Short; one head-to-head challenge, retries allowed

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game - one full play-through of any arcade cabinet in the game. Find a cabinet, start the game and finish it; the official description asks for a completion, not a high score. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the world
Start its game and play it through to completion
The trophy unlocks when the game is completed
trophies.effort: Short; a single cabinet session

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand of missions to its end: finish his final mission and the trophy unlocks. Stranger and friend strands can be followed on the map as they appear; no source reports this one as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand as it appears
Complete his final mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: A side strand across several sessions

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work Kenton's strand of missions to its end: finish his final mission and the trophy unlocks. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand as it appears
Complete his final mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: A side strand across several sessions

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work Billy's strand of missions to its end: finish his final mission and the trophy unlocks. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand as it appears
Complete his final mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: A side strand across several sessions

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida - whole strands, not single encounters. The plural is part of the platform name (some early editorial lists singularised it). Start strands as their markers appear and finish what you start; the individual finale trophies for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone sit inside this wider count. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag.
steps: Pick up stranger mission strands as their markers appear
Finish each strand through its final mission
The trophy unlocks at the 8th completed strand
trophies.effort: Long; woven through the whole playthrough

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work Randy's strand of missions to its end: finish his final mission and the trophy unlocks. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand as it appears
Complete his final mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: A side strand across several sessions

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work Tyrone's strand of missions to its end: finish his final mission and the trophy unlocks. The platform name capitalises On, and it is kept that way here. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand as it appears
Complete his final mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.effort: A side strand across several sessions

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The one missable watch on this list. PowerPyx and U7Buy both flag the status as under investigation: a meditation spot reached in Chapter 1 may not be reachable again later. Until that is settled, meditate at every spot the first time you reach it.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida - and treat this as the list's one missable watch. PowerPyx's guide flags the trophy as under investigation because a Chapter 1 spot may not reopen later; U7Buy says the same. The safe play costs nothing: meditate on arrival, every time, from the first spot onward. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start; PowerPyx.
steps: From Chapter 1 onward, meditate at each meditation spot the first time you reach it
Keep using every new spot as you explore Leonida
The trophy unlocks at the final spot
trophies.requirements: Every meditation spot across Leonida, used on first arrival
trophies.effort: Short per spot; the risk is skipping one, not the doing
trophies.reading: The description is plain: meditation spots are placed across Leonida and the trophy wants every one of them used. The only open question is whether early spots stay reachable.
trophies.habit: Meditate the moment you first reach any spot, before moving on. That habit covers the Chapter 1 spot even if it never reopens, at zero extra cost.
trophies.signal: Confirmation will come from players who skipped an early spot: if they can return to it after Chapter 1, the watch lifts; if not, meditate-on-arrival is the method.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret - a named quarry, not general hunting. Take Bret's hunt when it is offered and bring down the unique animal it points you at. No source reports it as missable. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Take the hunting job from Bret
Track and hunt the unique animal it names
The trophy unlocks when the hunt is delivered
trophies.effort: Short; one directed hunt

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida and gathered into sets, so this is a collection sweep: pick up every card you come across from the start rather than hunting them all at the end. The platform name uses the typographic apostrophe and it is kept here. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Collect cards wherever you find them, from the start of the game
Track which sets are close to complete and hunt their missing cards
The trophy unlocks when the 3rd set is completed
trophies.effort: Long; a collection sweep across the whole map

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations - the description's own wording, with the platform's exact WAiNKer casing kept in the name. Whatever the interaction proves to be in play, the shape is a 100-location sweep: use each new location as you reach it instead of backtracking at the end. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag.
steps: Use the WAiNK interaction at each new location you reach
Keep a running count toward 100 locations
The trophy unlocks at the 100th location
trophies.effort: Long; a location sweep across the whole map

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges - the game's running challenge list. Challenges accumulate as you play, so check the list whenever you are between missions and clear the nearly-done ones; the count reaches 50 faster than it looks. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Open the challenge list regularly as you play
Clear challenges in batches, favouring the nearly complete
The trophy unlocks at the 50th completed challenge
trophies.effort: Moderate; steady background progress

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4 star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the heat together. The official description sets both halves: the four stars and the clean getaway, with your partner present. Plan the escape before you start the trouble - a fast car and a route out of the search area. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Have your partner with you and a getaway vehicle ready
Raise the Wanted Level to 4 stars
Break line of sight, lose the level and escape the heat together
trophies.requirements: A 4 star Wanted Level lost and escaped, with your partner present
trophies.effort: Short; one planned set-piece, retries are free

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the Wanted Level alive between them - the official wording forbids losing the heat mid-run, so plan a tight triangle of shops and move straight from one to the next. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Pick three shops close together and have your partner with you
Rob the first and keep the Wanted Level active
Rob the second and third back-to-back before the heat drops
trophies.requirements: 3 shop robberies in one unbroken Wanted run, with your partner
trophies.effort: Short; one planned route, retries are free

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles - getting into a vehicle for the first time is what registers it in this kind of list, so make a habit of hopping into anything new you see parked or passing. The count builds naturally if you vary what you drive instead of living in one car. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Enter every new vehicle model you come across
Vary what you drive between missions
The trophy unlocks at the 100th discovered vehicle
trophies.effort: Moderate; builds naturally if you keep switching vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus - one activation, five takedowns. Set it up deliberately: start a fight with at least five enemies in reach, trigger Combat Focus once, and work through them before it ends. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); TrueAchievements; Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies in reach
Activate Combat Focus once
Take down 5 enemies before that single use ends
trophies.requirements: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus activation
trophies.effort: Short; a set-up fight, retries are free

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA - the airport. In plain terms the description points at taking off in an aircraft from VCIA outside any scheduled flight: get onto the airfield, take a plane, and leave by air. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Get onto the airfield at VCIA
Take an aircraft that is not part of a mission or schedule
Take off - the departure is the trophy
trophies.effort: Short; one trip to the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description - Kinda hot in these Rhinos - is all anyone has at launch: Output Lag lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed and no source has verified a trigger yet, so this page invents no steps. What follows is a labelled reading, the habit that covers it, and the signal that will confirm it. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
trophies.effort: Unknown until the method is confirmed
trophies.reading: Rhino is the tank line in this series, and the wording reads like time spent in one under pressure - most plausibly staying in a Rhino while it takes heavy fire or burns. That is an inference from the description alone, not a verified method.
trophies.habit: When you get hold of a Rhino, stay in it and keep fighting rather than bailing at the first serious damage. If the trigger is endurance under fire, that habit covers it at no cost.
trophies.signal: A pop while you are inside a damaged or burning Rhino confirms the reading. A pop on simply entering one would rewrite it - either way, the first verified unlock reports will settle it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected - a clean stealth job: get in, take the goods and get out with no detection at any point. Scout the store first, move quietly, and leave before anything escalates. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch how it is staffed and guarded
Enter quietly and take the goods without raising detection
Leave undetected and the trophy unlocks
trophies.requirements: One jewelry store robbed with zero detection
trophies.effort: Short; one careful job, retries are free

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time - the escape is part of the requirement, so a vault only counts when you get away. Treat each bank as a small heist: plan the exit before you go in, and work a different vault each run. (One early editorial list misspelt this as Withdrawl; the platform name is Withdrawal.) Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape cleanly
Repeat at different vaults, keeping a count
The trophy unlocks after the 5th successful vault escape
trophies.requirements: 5 bank vaults robbed, each with an escape
trophies.effort: Moderate; five small heists

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape - hit the truck, take what it carries, and get away. Armored trucks are tougher than ordinary traffic, so bring the means to stop one and a fast car for the exit. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it and take its cargo
Escape and the trophy unlocks
trophies.requirements: One armored truck robbed, with an escape
trophies.effort: Short; one roadside job, retries are free

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida - the whole state uncovered. This one rewards the completionist sweep: travel every district, island and back road until no part of the map is left unvisited. Leave it late in the roadmap, when your other trophies have already taken you most places, and mop up the gaps. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Explore as you work through the rest of the list
Late in the run, check the map for any district never visited
Visit the remaining areas until all of Leonida is explored
trophies.effort: Long; mostly a by-product of the rest of the list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang - one per gang, so variety is the requirement, not volume. As you learn which operations belong to which gang, keep a tally and deliberately visit the gangs you have not hit yet. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Find an illegal operation and rob it, noting which gang it belongs to
Repeat for each other gang's operations
The trophy unlocks when every gang has been robbed once
trophies.requirements: One illegal operation robbed per gang
trophies.effort: Moderate; a tour of every gang's turf

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. Output Lag lists this trophy among the launch list's unconfirmed methods and no source has verified its trigger yet, so this page invents no steps. The name ends with a real ellipsis character, exactly as the platforms serve it. What follows is a labelled reading, the habit that covers it, and the signal that will confirm it. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag.
trophies.effort: Unknown until the method is confirmed; the covering habit costs minutes
trophies.reading: The description puts a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: most plausibly a specific bar or spot there where having a drink with the ocean in view is the trigger. Its place at the head of the list hints at an early-game moment.
trophies.habit: On your first visit to Ocean Beach, stop at a bar with a sea view and have a cocktail instead of passing through. Doing it early covers the chance that the moment belongs to the game's opening hours.
trophies.signal: A pop immediately after drinking at an Ocean Beach spot confirms the reading; unlock reports will show whether any bar works or one viewpoint is required.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. Output Lag lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed at launch and no source has verified a trigger, so this page invents no steps. What follows is a labelled reading, the habit that covers it, and the signal that will confirm it. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
trophies.effort: Unknown until the method is confirmed
trophies.reading: Smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style reads as driving a car out through the showroom glass - either a scripted moment inside a mission or a repeatable piece of free-roam mischief at a dealership. The description alone cannot separate the two.
trophies.habit: Whenever a mission or a theft puts you inside a vehicle showroom, leave by driving out through the front glass rather than a door or a rear exit.
trophies.signal: A pop as a car breaks through showroom glass confirms the reading; if reports show it popping only inside one named mission, it is story-gated after all.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description names both the venue and the manner: follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The natural reading is a full game bowled at that specific alley, finished rather than abandoned - so this page gives the plain steps the description supports, plus the reading behind them. The platform name is plural and uses the typographic apostrophe. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Play a game of bowling there
Finish the game - follow-through means seeing it to the end
trophies.requirements: A completed game at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
trophies.effort: Short; one full game of bowling
trophies.reading: Follow-through is bowling language for completing the motion - applied to the alley, it most plausibly means completing a whole game at that venue instead of starting one and walking away.
trophies.habit: Finish every bowling game you start at Kolt & Associates', and make your first game there rather than at another alley, so the venue is never the missing piece.
trophies.signal: A pop on the results screen of a completed game at that alley confirms the reading; if it pops mid-game, reports will show the narrower trigger.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vaguest wording on the list: a partnership with mass appeal. No source has pinned the trigger at launch, so the steps below are the plain ones the description supports - partner play, done well - and the reading, habit and signal are labelled as inference, not fact. Sources: Exophase (PSN); XCT.live (Xbox catalog); Output Lag; Press Start.
steps: Take part in activities together with your partner
Push for your best shared performance at one of them
The trophy is expected to unlock when that shared best lands
trophies.requirements: A best shared performance with your partner (reading - unconfirmed)
